color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
0 · CURATE
you, in Zotero
Breadth is the whole job here.
A thin corpus shows up
immediately as a thin survey.
papers/bibliography.bib
+ papers/pdfs/ — deep-research is the
only skill that reads those, and it may
only discuss them by title, never cite them

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HEAVY — worth it for this genre
full_pipeline.py --stages docling,embed
docling → layout-aware .md + .passages.json
better quotable passages, so claims survive review
embed → content/chroma/
semantic recall: finds the paper that argues the
point in different words. Both skills name
embed_index.search() by hand.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · DRAFT
every sentence is a cited claim
survey-writer — over-fetch k=15,
hand-cluster into 2-4 sub-themes,
comparison table + gap analysis
deep-research — perspectives,
parallel interviews, contradiction map,
then cited sections
content/drafts/<slug>.md

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · VERIFY
src.citation_gate
Highest citation density
in the repo, so this
is the genre where
the gate earns its keep

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

p.small:
swap the key for one retrieval
actually returned, or drop the claim.
Never invent one.

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · PUBLISH
src.references → IEEE list
render_output --format tex
--format pdf · --format md
content/rendered/<slug>.pdf

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
afterwards, by you — not a gate
--stages provenance · verbatim_check.py
src.citation_coverage
“retrieval surfaced it — did the draft cite it?”
only meaningful when the corpus is the argument

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bertopic → content/topics.json
no skill calls this. It is for you, deciding what
the survey should even be about.

svg.text: Genre A — corpus-led writers: survey-writer, deep-research
